title: Rasan basta haram
body:
rasan basta haram majboor aur lachaar phirte hai
barehna sar barehna pa sare bazaar phirte hai
rasan basta haram…
<<DIVIDER>>
galay mein tauq hai zanjeere pa chalne nahi deti
magar kaanto ke upar abide bemaar phirte hai
rasan basta haram…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha karte thay abid umr bhar zainab se ro ro kar
phuphi ankhon mein zindan ke dar o dewaar phirte hai
rasan basta haram…
<<DIVIDER>>
buka karti thi sughra raton ko furqat mein baba ki
watan ko dekhiye kab sayyede abrar phirte hai
rasan basta haram…
<<DIVIDER>>
phirayi jaati hai dar dar rasoole paak ki itrat
mahaar unton ki pakde abide bemaar phirte hai
rasan basta haram…
<<DIVIDER>>
hayat ek ek ko hasrat se dekha karta hai pehro
kabhi jo karbala se shaah ke zawwar phirte hai
rasan basta haram…
author: Hayat Amrohi
